name: Ghost of Us
source:
Welcome to The Ghost of Us – a heart-wrenching tale where corporate ambition collides with the mysteries of memory. Step into Rachel Rodriguez's world, a driven product manager whose deepest connection begins to unravel as she questions reality itself. Was Allan Yates, her brilliant engineer and closest confidant, ever real? Explore a story of professional triumphs, emotional bonds, and haunting revelations in this visually stunning mobile visual novel.

[From [url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/ghost-of-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《The Ghost of Us》——一段职场野心与记忆谜团激烈碰撞的虐心故事。步入干练进取的产品经理蕾切尔·罗德里格斯的世界；当她开始质疑现实本身时，她内心最深切的那份羁绊也随之分崩离析。她那才华横溢的工程师搭档兼最亲密的知己艾伦·耶茨，究竟是否真实存在过？在这款画面惊艳的移动端视觉小说中，探索一段交织着职场荣光、深情羁绊与惊人真相的故事吧。

[摘自[url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/ghost-of-us]itch.io[/url]]
